answer: Imagine a shale cliff built one layer per epoch: weight equals layers cubed, and a pulse each epoch verifies every layer belongs to the same climber, so layers cannot be peeled off and pasted onto a fresh face. A cliff six layers high weighs 216 at its zenith; six fresh cliffs weigh 6 in total. I climb one cliff honestly, pay one slow climb, and earn only what its own height has earned.
